Thank you for your continued support.

We would like to share the analysis details for the Incident MFTBCFFR-5180, related to Tax amount finalization error.

Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number |MFTBCFFR-5180|
|Description|Tax amount finalization error|
|User Steps|Step 1: In the related UV Sales Quote, user has manually changed the items of Tax and Expenses and updated one Expense Item to 'Tax'.
Step 2: User created a Sales Order.
Step 3: User created an Invoice and completed it.
Step 4: User created a Registration Request and clicked on 'Finalize Tax Amount' button.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|We have successfully replicated this issue in UAT-1 environment (Reference Record: UV Sales Quote : 1-6XPN5P revision 5, UV Sales Order : E001300882).
When an invoice is created, the status of line items with Type as 'Tax' is automatically updated to Invoiced. However, a manually updated line item with Part Number 'YN6M' and Type as 'Tax' did not have its status changed to Invoiced.
During Tax Finalization, the status of all line items having Type as 'Tax', including manually updated ones (such as part number YN6M), must be set to Invoiced.|
|Recovery status|Please note that we have checked and found that no such case of manually updating the Expense Line item to 'Tax' has been observed in any FDP Production Environment.
As this is a case of user misoperation, so no recovery is required.
Kindly ask the user to revise the UV Sales Quote, and update the correct expense line items. |
|Fix Plan|NA|

As this is a case of user mis-operation, we would like to proceed with closing this Jira ticket.

If you require further clarification or assistance, please feel free to reach out.

21/Jul/26 6:56 AM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear Tsunoda San,

 

型式コードがD21Aファイル処理時点でシステムに登録されていない場合については、以下のような対応を実装することが可能です。

 

型式コードが存在しない場合は、シャーシオーダーを作成しない。

対象レコードの情報をAMSチームへメールで自動通知する。

AMSチームにて通知内容を確認し、必要なデータ修正を実施した後、再処理を行う。

 

この対応により、型式コードが未登録の状態でシャーシオーダーが作成されることを防止し、問題の早期検知および迅速な対応が可能となります。

 

ご不明な点やご質問がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。

 

よろしくお願いいたします。

 

(English)

 

In such scenario where Model Code is not present in the system at the time of D12A file execution. We can apply changes in the system such that in such cases the Chassis Order will not be created in the system and report of the affected record will be send to the AMS team over mail to track for the issue and do the necessary correction for the issue.
Please let us know in case of some further query.

 

 

Best Regards,

Thank you for your support.

We have checked this issue and found that input Branch Code is checked by comparing it with JCO creator's Primary Location Code, which is '70' for I000111578(D8YOOSEK has 70) and '00' for I000111572(D8MICSAS has 00).
 !image-2025-12-15-19-26-42-144.png|width=527,height=256!
 !image-2025-12-15-19-30-06-226.png|width=527,height=252!

This can be checked in Employee's Location Code(JCO Creator).
 As per current logic, Branch Code which is used to issue Invoice and JCO creator's Primary Department Code must be same, Branch Code validation has been changed through MFTBCFFR-4379 CR which will be released on 17th December release. The invoice for I000111578 can be issued using Branch Code 70 for now.

Please find attached the requested API data [^I000111572_invoice.json][^I000111578_invoice.json] .
 Kindly let us know in case of any queries, if further clarification is required, we will schedule a meeting as per Yoshihara San's convenience to discuss this issue.

Best Regards,
 Atul Yadav
column396:
16/Dec/25 5:56 AM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;Dear [~accountid:712020:3bbdff6f-1498-435b-a25d-bf833b44b3f6]  San,

いつもお世話になっております。

 

本件について確認したところ、入力された Branch Code は、JCO 作成者の Primary Location Code と照合してチェックされていることが判明しました。

具体的には、I000111578（D8YOOSEK）の Primary Location Code は「70」、I000111572（D8MICSAS）の Primary Location Code は「00」となっております。
!image-2025-12-15-19-26-42-144.png|width=438,height=213!
!image-2025-12-15-19-30-06-226.png|width=437,height=209!

本件は、従業員の Location Code（JCO 作成者）にて確認可能です。

 

現行のロジックでは、請求書発行に使用する Branch Code と、JCO 作成者の Primary Department Code が一致している必要があります。

なお、Branch Code のバリデーションは、CR「MFTBCFFR-4379」にて変更されており、12月17日のリリースで適用予定です。

それまでの対応として、I000111578 の請求書は Branch Code「70」を使用して発行可能です。

 

ご依頼いただいた API データは上のコメントに追加されておりますので、ご確認ください。

 

ご不明点や追加のご説明が必要な場合はお知らせください。

 

 

よろしくお願いいたします。

いつもお世話になっております。

2025年12月4日にご報告いただいた、和歌山本番環境のNV受注における納車承認エラー（MFTBCFFR-5069）について、調査結果をご報告いたします。

|インシデント番号|MFTBCFFR-5069|
|事象|NV受注にて納車承認時にエラーが発生し、処理を完了できない事象が発生しました。|
|RCA|対象のNV受注（A000009087、A000011464）は、いずれも商品クラスが「Trailer」であることを確認しております。この場合、受注が承認されると、システムにより「Trailer & Forklift」タイプの発注書が自動作成されます。
!image-20260617-120257.png|width=324,alt="image-20260617-120257.png"!
その後、発注書のステータスを「Ordered」に変更すると、新しい車両レコードが自動作成され、その車両IDが発注書および関連する受注に設定される仕組みとなっております。
対象レコードでは、受注承認および発注書作成までは正常に完了しており、発注書を「Ordered」に変更した際にも車両レコードは正常に作成されていました。
しかし、作成された車両の車両IDは発注書には正常に設定されたものの、対応する受注には設定されていませんでした。

Dear Tsunoda san

Thank you for your continued support.

We would like to share the analysis details for the incident# MFTBCFFR-5069 reported on December 04, 2025, related to delivery approval error in NV Sales Order on Wakayama Production environment.

Please find the summary below:

|Incident Number|MFTBCFFR-5069|
|Description|A delivery approval error was displayed in NV Sales Order, thus preventing the user from completing the process.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|Please note that both affected NV Sales Order# A000009087 and A000011464, have product class as 'Trailer'. In this case, when the Sales Order is Approved, a purchase order having type as 'Trailer & Forklift' is automatically created. 
!image-20260617-120424.png|width=250,alt="image-20260617-120424.png"!
Subsequently, when the status of this Purchase Order is updated to "Ordered", the system creates a new Vehicle record and populates its Vehicle ID in both the Purchase Order and the corresponding Sales Order.
For the affected records in Wakayama Production, the Sales Orders were approved successfully and the corresponding Purchase Orders were generated. When the Purchase Orders status was updated to "Ordered", new Vehicle records were created as expected.
However, the issue occurred because the Vehicle Id of this newly created Vehicle was populated correctly in the Purchase Order but was not populated in the corresponding Sales Order. During the Delivery Approval process, the system validates the Vehicle information between the Purchase Order and Sales Order. Due to the Vehicle ID mismatch, the validation failed and the Delivery Approval error message was displayed.|
|Recovery status|Completed|
|Fix Plan|We have reviewed this issue at the code level and confirmed that there is no defect in the current implementation and the process is working as expected. We attempted to replicate this issue in UAT environment but this issue could not be replicated.
We have monitored this issue over the past few months, and no recurrence has been observed on any production environment.
Also please note that the affected Purchase Orders were completed in March 2025 whereas the issue was reported in December 2025. Due to the significant time gap , some information is not available to access the issue. As a result, while we were able to identify that the Delivery Approval error was caused by a Vehicle ID mismatch between the Purchase Order and Sales Order, we do not currently have sufficient information to determine why the Vehicle ID was not populated in the Sales Order at that time. 
We will continue to monitor the system, and if a similar issue occurs in the future, we will investigate it immediately and take the necessary corrective actions.
Since there are no pending actions at this time and the issue has not recurred, we would like to proceed with closing this ticket.|

Regards
Sunaina Gill

Thank you for your continued support.

We have completed our analysis of the reported issue and would like to share our findings. 

RCA (Root Cause Analysis):
During our of Parts Sales Return Orders where the VIN# and Registration# fields were blank, we observed that the corresponding parent Parts Sales Orders and the originating Parts Quotes also contained blank values for these fields. Since the VIN# and Registration# details were not entered at the initial Parts Quote stage, the same was carried forward to the Parts Sales Order and subsequently to the Parts Sales Return Order.

For validation, we created two sample records  on FDP UAT1 for Parts Sales Return Orders:
M001300484 – with VIN# and Registration# populated
M001300482 – with no VIN# and Registration# 
The PBI report(PT5-10) correctly reflected the VIN of M001300484 as VIN values added in Parts quote.

 
Based on our analysis, this behavior is not an issue on the Siebel side or the PBI side. The root cause is that the VIN# and Registration# fields were not entered by the user at the time of creating the initial Parts Quote.

Since it is not a system issue, kindly allow us to reject this incident.  

Please let us know if you require any further information.

Best Regards,
Abhinav

27/Nov/25 4:41 PM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear [~accountid:712020:3bbdff6f-1498-435b-a25d-bf833b44b3f6] san,

Thanks for your support.

*RCA*:

*(1) Reason for Payment Terms were included in UAT4–8 but not reflected in PROD:*
 The Payment Condition values displayed in the BIP are based on the PO Sheet master. During the initial setup for Wave-3, the master data for these Payment Conditions was not provided by biz.
 When the incident *MFTBCFFR-4978* was raised, the missing values were added across all UAT environments, and the master data was uploaded based on the values that were already present in *OKAYAMA-PROD*. However, since the required master data was not available during the initial PROD deployment, the Payment Terms were not reflected in the Wave-3 PROD environments.

*(2) Reason for differences across FDP environments (Wave-3 & Chugoku):*
 In the Shikoku and Wakayama PROD environments, hardcoded Payment Condition values already exist in the BIP configuration. Therefore, Payment Terms appear only in these specific FDP environments.
 In contrast, other FDPs i.e. *Iwate, Okinawa, and Chugoku,* do not have such hardcoded values, which results in the observed differences in Payment Term display across Wave-3 PROD environments.

*Fix and release plan:*
As discussed in the meeting, after the issue was fixed on UAT and since all the UAT environments are in sync now, we are planning to release the UAT changes to PROD on *29th November after business hours*.

Kindly review and approve the PROD release for the respective FDPs so that we can proceed with the changes to PROD on *29th November*.

Please let us know in case of any queries.

Best Regards,
Soham

column396:
26/Nov/25 1:23 AM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear Tsunoda san,

Thank you for your continued support.

We have thoroughly investigated this issue, and our findings are as follows:

*Issue:*
 The user was unable to print the "仕様書 2" BIP report.

*Root Cause:*
 The price for Part MK645741 was found to be null, which caused the BIP report to fail, as the price field cannot be null for part line items.
 Additionally, we identified that users are able to edit the quantity directly in the Sales Order, which is not aligned with the correct business process. Quantity changes must be performed through the Quote. Since the user modified the quantity in the Sales Order, the price was set to null, resulting in the BIP failure.

A similar incident occurred previously in the SC version (INC4031968). As part of the fix for that issue, the quantity field was made read-only to prevent modifications in the Sales Order.

Please find below the screenshot of UAT test record for your reference:
 !image-2025-11-26-10-23-28-568.png|width=424,height=206!

*Fix Plan:*
 We will apply the same approach by making the quantity field read-only for parts. This will prevent null price errors and ensure that BIP reports are generated successfully.

Kindly review and confirm our proposed fix plan. Please let us know if you have any questions or need further clarification.

Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya

We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-5016 reported on 25th November 2025, related to the JV of consumption tax of Accounts Receivable was not created, after Sales Posting Customer Account was Changed.

Please find the summary below:


|Incident Number |MFTBCFFR-5016|
|Description|NV FDP中国 売上後の取引先変更で消費税の仕訳が出ない|
|Root Cause (RCA)|When NV/UV Quote is revised after SO Sales Posting, and certain field values(Price and other info) are changed, Revised Journal Vouchers are created
 with the updated values. In this case, Customer Account is changed and upon quote approval, only 'Revise Sales Posting Selling' JV was created, Consumption Tax JV was not created. We have replicated this issue on UAT1:
SO # A001299134, A001299093

This issue occurred because as per the existing logic, Revise Journal Voucher is created only for those Journal Vouchers Items where Sales Amount is changed, if Selling Amount is not changed then in that case only one JV 'Revise Sales Posting Selling' is created.|
|Recovery status|Will do after confirmation from Shiromoto San|
|Fix Plan|To fix this, we will update the logic so that Consumption Tax Journal is created with 'Revise Sales Posting Selling' Journal
 even if Sales Amount is not changed and other values like account is changed.
We will fix it on UAT by today end of day, if fix approval is received.|
|Planned UAT date|25th November, 2025|
|Next update|26th November, 2025|

Also, response to your queries is :
 1. *Is there any past JV？* >> Since this logic has been in place since FDP go-live, there are past JVs affected.

2.  *For UV, is it in the same situation of After Sales Posting?* >> Yes, the same functionality applies to UV as well.

3. *Do other FDPs have same specification?*>> Yes, the logic is same across all FDPs.


The issue has been *fixed on UAT1* after receiving your approval for the fix plan.
 We have also received *production deployment approval* from Shiromoto San, and this will be released in the *26th November release*.

Thank you for your support.

We have investigated this issue and would like to share our findings with you.

*Root Cause Analysis (RCA):*
 We have successfully replicated the issue on Parts Purchase Return Order *#N001300132* on *FDP-UAT1*.
 Our analysis showed that *Return Good Qty* and *Return Defective Qty* fields become editable when the shipment is processed using the *“Shipped”* button. As a result, users are able to modify these quantities even after the shipment is marked as shipped. This leads to the creation of incorrect actions and transactions for the line item.

*Fix Plan:*
 * We will make *Return Good Qty* and *Return Defective Qty* permanently *read-only*, regardless of shipment status.
 * We will fix this issue on *FDP-UAT1 by 18/11/2025 (EOD)*.

Please let us know if you have any questions or require further clarification.

Abhinav

Thank you for your support.

We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:

This issue occurred due to a difference in the Model Codes.
 
The user initially created the Chassis Order B050208984 with the Model Code FBA20B21W00F-5-G830, and the corresponding vehicle record was also created with this Model Code on 30 May 2025.
 
On 7 November 2025, a D21A file was received from TOB, containing the same Model Code FBA20B21W00F-5-G830.
 
However, after the vehicle was created on 30 May 2025, the Model Code in the vehicle record was modified by user from FBA20B21W00F-5-G830 to FBA20B21W00F-4-G830.
 
Due to this mismatch, the current D21A ODI package identified the data as a new record and consequently created a new vehicle and a new chassis order B050481404, resulting in duplication in chassis order and recycle fee order and line items.


This is a case of User mis-operation where user updated the model code in vehicle due to which correct file with MC 5 created a duplicate order. 

Additionally, these type of cases will be handled by Vehicle cleansing CR. Since, recovery is completed and no further action is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this incident. 

Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.

After the data extraction, an update SQL is used to update the flag of the record that is been sent to KB in bulk processing. This SQL was updating the flag on the basis of the order number rather than shipment. If any order had one target shipment to be sent to KB, the flag was updated for all the shipment. 

We have now fixed this SQL on all the production environment and correct flag updates are made now.

Thanks for your support.

*RCA*: The performance issue in the “Order Confirmation Shipment” screen while using the PDQ '02_当月販売' was caused primarily by the query design. The PDQ uses the condition JulianMonth([MF Shipment Date]) = JulianMonth(Today()), which applies a function directly on the date column. This makes the condition non-searchable using indexes, preventing the database from using the index on [MF Shipment Date] and forcing a full table scan. Additionally, multiple OR conditions on [MF Order Type] and [MF UI Pickup Status] further increased query complexity, and the absence of row limits resulted in large data retrieval, slowing both screen loading and data export. Since the same PDQ logic is used across all FDP environments, the slowness was observed in all FDP-PROD except for FDP-Okayama where the PDQ does not exist.

We'll provide the detailed analysis on the ways for improving the load time for this screen soon since multiple parameters are involved. Meanwhile, please let us know in case of any query.

Best Regards,

09/Dec/25 6:40 AM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear [~accountid:712020:5fe8ae34-3387-45a6-ae3d-cedf7aac0300] san,
Thank you for your support.



We have thoroughly analyzed this issue, and our findings are as follows:

The user is creating an Insurance Order and then generating the Policy Number through the Ejibai interface. However, the Ejibai response is not being sent back to Siebel. Instead, the policy is created in Ejibai, and the user is manually updating the Liability Insurance Policy # field in the Insurance Order, as it is currently editable.

When the Policy Number is populated in the Insurance Order through the Ejibai response, the backend field User Key gets updated automatically. However, when the Policy Number is entered manually, the User Key remains null. Therefore, when that same policy is sent again from Ejibai to Siebel, the system does not find the original record (due to the missing User Key) and creates a duplicate order.

We successfully replicated this issue on UAT4 with the help of Gayatri-san. Please refer to the Insurance Order Q000037255 and its duplicate Q000037256.

Replication steps performed:

Step 1: Created an Insurance Order in Siebel and proceeded with policy creation on the Ejibai side.

Step 2: Manually updated the Liability Insurance Policy # in the Insurance Order instead of sending the response from the Ejibai interface.

Step 3: Sent the Policy Number again from Ejibai.

Conclusion:
This is not a system defect but a user mis-operation, where the Policy Number is being updated manually rather than being linked through the Ejibai interface. Kindly inform the user to avoid such manual updates to prevent duplication issues.

Since no further action is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this incident. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.

Regards,

 Thank you for your support and cooperation.

As per our discussion and demonstration in the meeting. We explained why the Order Detail BIP report failed to generate in case of Trailer & Forklift.
 *Issue* : Failure in generation of Order Detail BIP report.
 *Cause* : Tax rate was null in Sales Order as well as in Sales Quote. *Tax rate* is calculated on the basis of *Planned Delivery Date* in the sales quote which is then passed on to the Sales Order. In case of Trailer and Forklift, the validation on Planned Delivery Date is not present to get the Sales Quote approval due to which, the tax rate is not calculated *whenever the date field is left empty* in the sales quote. As a result null tax rate is passed on to the Sales Order causing the BIP to fail.
 We plan and hope to provide the fix by today EOD on UAT environment.

Best Regards,
 Saad

*Issue*: Different Model Codes were present in Quote and Sales Order.

*RCA*: We have found that Chassis & Options Tab in Line Items of NV Sales Order is editable for some responsibilities.
 !Evidence1.png|thumbnail! 
 Instead of changing the Model code from NV Quote, some users were changing the Model Code from this tab in Sales Order. Please find attached all the impacted NV Sales Orders. 
 [^Recovery_Records_FDP.xlsx] 

*Fix Plan*: Model Code should not be changed from the NV Sales Order. The correct business procedure for changing Model code is to change the model code from the NV Quote and then sync the Quote to Sales Order. Hence we will make the Product Name field read only in Chassis & Options tab. This will ensure that no such user miss-operations happens again. 

Kindly approve this fix plan.

一部の責任区分において、NV受注（NVSO)の明細にある「シャーシ & オプション」タブが編集可能となっていました。

31/Oct/25 12:00 AM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear [~accountid:712020:3bbdff6f-1498-435b-a25d-bf833b44b3f6] san,

Thank you for your support.

*RCA*:
As discussed in the meeting, this issue occurred due to the execution of the file received for the Lubrication Master (i.e. MFTBCFFR - 4830) for UAT1 and FDP-Okayama. The file contained the value ‘N’ for the Generic Flag field. As a result, the pre-default logic in the Lubrication Master led to the 'Outsourcing Lubricant Carry-in' field being set to ‘N’, since this value is directly derived from the Lubrication Master data.
For Dummy Lubrication Parts, the value of this flag should always be ‘Y’ in the master data.

The recovery has been completed, and we have reset the value of the Generic Flag back to ‘Y’.

*Countermeasure*:
As discussed, whenever the Lubrication Price Master data needs to be uploaded, we kindly request you to:
->Provide only the Price files if updates are required only for the lubrication pricing.
->Provide both Lubrication Master and Lubrication Price Master files if new lubrication data needs to be added in the FDPs.
Additionally, we will update our SOP to include a check for the Generic Flag value for dummy parts whenever a Lubrication Master file is received. We will also inform you in case any data update is required to maintain consistency across systems.

Since this was a data issue and not a system issue, please allow us to close this incident.

Please let us know in case of any queries.

Best Regards,
Soham

When *two columns have the same Japanese translation*, Power BI export fails because both fields get the *same alias name* in the export query.

 “ファイルの作成失敗 – データのエクスポート操作に対するクエリの実行でエラーが発生しました。”

Thank you for your continued support.

 

We have analyzed the issue and would like to share the following findings:

Root Cause Analysis (RCA):

When a Job Card (JC) is initially created from the NV or UV side, the “Internal Order (Charge To)” field is populated. However, if the user changes the JC Type to any other Type let's say “11: Chargeable” while the JC Status is still Open, and then revert the JC Type back to NV or UV, the “Internal Order (Charge To)” field becomes blank.

16/Dec/25 9:38 AM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear [~accountid:712020:3bbdff6f-1498-435b-a25d-bf833b44b3f6] san,
Thank you for your support.

We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:

User is performing the following steps in service quote line item while updating the manual discount % in all the line items:
UAT1 test record "1-6WGYRW":

Step 1: Click on an editable field:
!image-2025-12-16-18-27-47-328.png|width=363,height=138!

Step 2: Now select all lines by clicking "Ctrl+A":
!image-2025-12-16-18-28-23-025.png|width=364,height=126!

Step 3: Click on Change Records and select the Manual Discount% and enter the field value to be updated for all line items and then click OK:
!image-2025-12-16-18-29-28-352.png|width=408,height=185!

Step 4: After clicking OK on Change records applet, the editable field in which user clicked in step 1 is changed :
!image-2025-12-16-18-30-49-779.png|width=411,height=160!

RCA: Change Records is a Siebel Vanilla functionality where it is observed that above steps in all quote line items leads to changing the value in initially selected editable fields. This phenomenon can be observed in other editable fields as well:
!image-2025-12-16-18-33-12-663.png|width=407,height=185!

Also this is not limited to Service Quotes only, we have replicated the same steps on parts quote too. 

This is a Siebel bug where the change record functionality is behaving in this manner. Current business process configuration is correct but this issue is arising because of the existing Siebel bug, 

Countermeasure: We should inform the users of Hakodate branch to perform such operations on read only fields so that such occurrence can be avoided. Users can click on read only fields or instead of selecting all the fields at once by ctrl+A they can select the records manually(If the cursor is at an editable field). This will ensure that such issue do not occur again. 

Since no further topic is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this ticket. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.

Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

Thank you for your support.

We have investigated the root cause and found that the sorting in the Journal Voucher is performed in the order of *Timestamp > Global Order Number > Data Set Separator*. Since both the timestamp and Global Order Number are the same in these cases, the grouping is being done based on the Data Set Separator.

This issue is very rare and has occurred only for a few records in Okayama.
M000204765
 M000244090
 M000303799
 M000315069
 M000364233
 M000401254
 M000433410
 M000442591
Please let us know if recovery is required for these records. If it is required , we will create reverse JV and correct JV in correct sequence.
 As discussed, implementing a fix would require significant changes to the existing logic. Therefore, we kindly request you to close this Jira once recovery has been completed for all affected records.

We will continue to monitor the system daily and perform recovery if any similar cases are detected in the future.
Please let us know if you have any questions or concerns.

Best Regards,

Thus, The values in Status code filters are different in both SC and FDP.

Thank you for your support.
We have checked this issue and following are the root cause , impacted records, fix plan and recovery plan for this issue:

*Root Cause:*

We have found that in Re-Edit CR logic, if Re-edit button is clicked on same day as job card was created, then *Sent to KB* flag is updated to "Y" for all JVs except latest closed ones. To do this, we query using Voucher Abstract in JV, and Expense JV(Tax - Weight Tax, Tax - Automobile Type, 'Tax - Automobile Env') are created when expense is completed i.e., it is created before latest Job Card JV is created.
So sent to KB flag was getting updated to "Y".

*Fix plan:* 
We will fix this issue on UAT and exclude Job Card JVs with Order Type *'Tax - Weight Tax, Tax - Automobile Type, 'Tax - Automobile Env'.*

*Recovery Plan:*
We have checked all FDP environments and only I000213439 and I000224933 *Tax - Weight Tax JVs* were found. To recovery this we will retrigger these two JVs and it will be linked to KB in tonight's daily batch.

Kindly let us know in case of any queries.

24/Sep/25 8:18 AM;712020:17b0808a-2569-4316-a76d-282e067c6a25;Dear Tsunoda-san,

Thank you for your continued support.

We have analyzed the issue, and please find our findings and resolution details below:

Issue: For recycle order, response from TOB side is received but not reflected in the order.

RCA: This issue occurs when duplicate recycle orders exist with the same Vehicle ID. In such cases, the TOB response is being reflected in the duplicate order instead of the correct one due to the matching Vehicle ID.
 For MS06GP-15519(Recycle Order: B000286143,Duplicate Order: B000283229)
 For MS06GP-15518(Recycle Order: B000286144,Duplicate Order: B000283228)

Fix: To prevent this issue from reoccurring, we have updated our recovery procedure. Specifically, during the recovery process, the Vehicle ID is now removed from any duplicate recycle orders to ensure proper mapping of TOB responses.

 

NOTE: Recovery for such records has been completed across all production environments. The Vehicle ID has been removed from all duplicate recycle orders. 
 Since no further action is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this Jira Ticket.

Please let us know if you have any questions or need additional information.

Best Regards

12/Sep/25 5:26 AM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear [~accountid:712020:66b35490-1d18-4551-8edc-a61d8fcec8ca] san,
 
Thank you for your support, and apologies for the inconvenience. Your understanding is correct.
 
*RCA*:
In the current logic, Before delivery approval a validation check is applied which checks  if shipment of any parts line item is Open or not. If such shipments are found then Validation message occurs on Delivery Approval. According to the current logic, shipment of Parts Purchase Orders are checked rather then Parts Internal Order. 
 
*Fix*:
To align with the validation, we will update the logic to check shipment of Parts Internal Order rather then Parts Purchase Order. This will ensure that no such cancelled parts(with Purchase Orders) cause error in Delivery Approval.
 
Kindly confirm our fix plan and let us know if you have any query.
 
Best Regards,
Soham
column401:
12/Sep/25 5:57 AM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;Dear [~accountid:712020:66b35490-1d18-4551-8edc-a61d8fcec8ca] san,

いつも大変お世話になっております。



原因分析（RCA）

現在のロジックでは、納品承認前に検証チェックが行われ、部品の出荷が「未完了（Open）」の品目が存在するかどうかを確認しています。該当する出荷が存在する場合、納品承認時にバリデーションエラーメッセージが表示されます。

現在のロジックでは、「部品購入オーダー（Parts Purchase Orders）」の出荷状況がチェックされており、「部品社内オーダー（Parts Internal Orders）」は対象外となっています。

 

修正内容

本来のバリデーションの意図に合わせ、ロジックを修正し、「部品購入オーダー」ではなく「部品社内オーダー」の出荷状況をチェックするようにいたします。

これにより、キャンセルされた部品（購入オーダー）によって納品承認時にエラーが発生することを防止できます。

 

修正方針についてご確認いただき、ご不明点等ございましたらお知らせください。

 

よろしくお願い申し上げます。

Thank you for your support.
 We have checked this issue and following is our analysis:
 1. When chassis order is created, "Class" in Vehicle is null, which can be changed at any point of time before Registration Completion of SO.
 !image-2025-09-17-13-20-05-390.png|width=489,height=240!

2. As per logic, if *Class* is null then Account Code is picked according to "*Vehicle Type*" in Vehicle. For the affected records, Class is either null or it was updated after JV creation. That is why Account Code in JV is set using Vehicle Type "Others" from Account Code Master.
 !image-2025-09-17-13-20-30-824.png|width=495,height=241!

3. We have checked Account Code Master and only following records are there, for vehicle type *('HDB','Kei-class car','1.5t','LDB','null','Others(e.g.Industrial engine)','Passenger car','MDB'),* there is no record in account code master that is why, Account Code with Vehicle Type "Others" is set in JV.
 !image-2025-09-17-13-21-04-260.png|width=536,height=366!

4. We have replicated it on UAT2.

           Correct Record(Class is not null): B000055605
            Incorrect Record(Class is null): B000055601
 !image-2025-09-17-13-18-34-584.png|width=497,height=210!

+*Fix Plan:*+ We will create account detail for all Vehicle Types in Account Item Code Master, so we request you to provide the details for creating the master data. If "Class" and "Vehicle Type" both are null then account detail in account code master with *Vehicle Type = Others* will be set.
 We are working on the recovery data(both Reverse JV and Correct JV), and we will share it with you as soon as possible.
 Please let us know in case of any queries.

Best Regards,
 Atul Yadav

03/Oct/25 5:24 AM;712020:94fdcacc-0060-496d-b5c5-0c1ac9d47d4c;Dear [~accountid:712020:66b35490-1d18-4551-8edc-a61d8fcec8ca] San,

Thank you for your support and cooperation.

The problem earlier was failure in generation of BIP report (Order Detail) generated after getting the Sales Order approved.

 This problem was occurring because the user might have entered the last contract date someday before the year 2020. 

 For example 09/10/2018. This field in editable so later on the user might have corrected it after sales order approval.

 This back date of 09/10/2018 was leading to fetching of null value in tax rate. This tax rate is calculated in the basis of last contract date by comparing it to the Start and End date of the Tax Value in the Tax Master table. The start date in the table is a day of year 2020. So entering a date before this day will lead to failure in BIP generation.

 We are attaching the issue replication steps. Following these steps, earlier their was issue of failure in BIP generation but now there will not be an issue anymore.
 [^Incident - 4611 v2_jpn.ppt]


Please let us know in case of any query.

Best Regards,
 Saad

Please find the below mentioned details of the issue.

*1.Root Cause:*
Timeout parameter was changed from 1 hour to 2 hours, which led to extended user sessions during peak load, amplifying memory leaks in the system.
*2. Technical Observation:*
During peak traffic, prolonged sessions resulted in higher memory utilization and session retention at web layer.
*3. Oracle / Siebel Recommendation:*
As per Oracle and Siebel best practices, timeout synchronization between web and application layers must be maintained. Setting a long timeout value is not recommended due to possible performance impact.
*4. Action Taken:*
Timeout parameter was reverted from 2 hours back to 1 hour. Post-change, system stability was restored.
*5. Countermeasure / Preventive Action:*
For any future requirement to extend the session time, it is advised to increase the timeout parameter gradually (e.g., in 10-minute intervals) and monitor system stability after each change.
*6. Future Plan:*
If performance instability persists even after gradual adjustment, infrastructure-level tuning will be considered to ensure long-term system stability.

Thank you.

 When the Trade-In flag is unchecked in the NV Quote header, the related Trade-In fields become read-only. This prevents deletion, as certain backend field updates required during deletion cannot occur in this state.
 *Recovery Plan:*
 No recovery action is required. The user can resolve the issue by rechecking the Trade-In flag to “Y”. This will allow deletion of the Trade-In Assessment as needed.

Conclusion:
 This is a case of user mis operation, not a system defect. Hence, kindly allow us to reject this incident.
 Please advise the user to follow the steps outlined above. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.

Regards,

09/Jul/26 4:13 PM;712020:1e07aa0c-b20d-4386-b63d-f7f813f8f67d;Dear [~accountid:712020:66b35490-1d18-4551-8edc-a61d8fcec8ca]  San,

 

いつもお世話になっております。

 

本件について調査を完了いたしましたので、原因（RCA）をご報告いたします。

 

持ち込み後付シャーシオーダー（Retro-fit Chassis Order）に対応するD21Zファイルを受信し、実際完了日（106桁目から4文字が「J」で始まるデータ）が設定されている場合、対象の持ち込み後付シャーシオーダー（Retro-fit Chassis Order）のステータスは**「完了済み（Completed）」**に更新される仕様となっております。

 

調査の結果、ステータスが「完了済み（Completed）」に更新されなかった原因は、ODI処理において受注のコードを**「11SC」で検索していたためでした。一方、FDPでは対象受注のコードが「本部（Headquarters）」**で作成されているため、条件が一致せず、ステータス更新が行われていませんでした。

 

本事象はODI処理の設定に起因するものであり、現在は対象ファイルに必要な修正を実施しております。これにより、今後は持ち込み後付シャーシオーダー（Retro-fit Chassis Order）について同様の事象は発生しない見込みです。

 

以上が本件の原因となります。

 

内容をご確認いただき、ご不明な点がございましたらお気軽にお問い合わせください。

 

よろしくお願いいたします。

 

(English)

Thank you for your support and cooperation.

We have completed our analysis for this issue and would like to share with you the root cause of this issue.

Whenever we receive the D21Z file for any corresponding “Retro-fit Chassis Order“ with Actual Completion Dates ( Starting with the character J at position 106 upto 4 Characters ). The Retrofit Chassis Order’s status should change to ‘Completed'.

As of now, the orders were not getting their Statuses set to "Completed" because the search command was matching the Order’s Division Type Code with ‘11SC', however in FDP, the orders are created with their Division Type Codes as ‘Headquarters’.

Due to this mismatch the Orders were not getting their Statuses updated. This issue is related to the ODI executions. We have implemented the required changes in the respective files. We hope the issue will not occur for any Retrofit Orders in the future.

We request you to please review the above RCA and let us know in case of any query.

Best Regards,
Saad

!image-20260710-055840 (8a30b2b7-838a-47ce-9f33-3b095886f9a3).png|width=250,alt="image-20260710-055840.png"!

添付資料のとおり、部門種別コード（Division Type Code） は、実際にはユーザーのポジションに紐づく組織タイプ（Organization Type） を参照しております。



中国環境を確認したところ、持ち込み後付オーダーは添付資料に記載の3つの組織に所属するポジションのユーザーによって作成されておりました。



一方で、「11SC」組織に所属するポジションから作成された持ち込み後付オーダーはありませんでした。



そのため、ODI処理では部門種別コードとして**「11SC」**を条件に検索していたため、対象の受注を取得できず、ステータスが更新されなかったことが本事象の原因です。



ご不明な点や追加で必要な情報がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。



よろしくお願いいたします。

We have updated the recycle fee order creation logic and with this enhancement, once a recycle fee order is created for a chassis order under a specific dealer code, subsequent processing of the same D21F file will no longer generate duplicate recycle fee orders.

Result:
Only one recycle fee order will be created for each chassis order, ensuring that duplicate recycle fee orders are no longer generated.

　　- リサイクルオーダー変更済「Recycle Order Changed」

　　- リサイクル変更中「Recycle Change In Progress」

　　- リサイクルキャンセル保留中（ペンディング）「Recycle Cancel Pending」

 

2) 注文変更ボタン（Change Order）：

以下の両方の条件を満たす場合に、このボタンは有効（アクティブ）になります。

 

TOBステータス：

　　TOB成功「TOB Success」

 

リサイクル料金注文ステータス： 以下のいずれか

　　- 完了済「Completed」

　　- リサイクルオーダー変更済「Recycle Order Changed」

 

3) 注文キャンセルボタン（Cancel Order）：

以下の3つの条件すべてを満たす場合に、このボタンは有効（アクティブ）になります。

 

TOBステータス：

　　’’TOBへ送信済’’以外「Status not equal to Submitted to TOB」

 

リサイクル料金注文ステータス： 以下のいずれか

　　- 完了済「Completed」

　　- リサイクルオーダー変更済「Recycle Order Changed」

転送機能に関してご報告いたします。

バックエンドのロジックによりますと、ユーザー間でポジションを転送するには、両者が同一の組織に所属している必要があります。そのため、D0X20851とD0X20852が異なる組織に所属している現在の状況では、「転送」機能は想定どおりの動作をしております。

 

いずれかのユーザー（D0X20851またはD0X20852）をもう一方と同じ組織に変更していただければ、任意のユーザーおよびポジションに対して転送が可能となります。

 

なお、「転送」ボタンをクリックすると、現在のユーザーに関連付けられたポジションが表示されますが、これは同一組織内に存在する場合に限られます。

 

以上の点を踏まえ、現在のテスト方法は正しく、システムは正常に動作していることをご報告申し上げます。

さらにIBOSからのレスポンスに対して検索条件（Search Specification）も追加しております。

 

UAT環境でのテストでは、JVが重複して作成される事象は確認されていません。

そのため、本番環境でどのような経路・条件でJVが重複して作成されているのかを引き続き監視・調査してまいります。

 

現在も考えられる原因を調べており、原因が特定でき次第、あらためてご報告いたします。

 

よろしくお願いいたします。
column411:
15/Jul/25 5:37 AM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear [~accountid:712020:66b35490-1d18-4551-8edc-a61d8fcec8ca] san,
 Thank you for your support.

We have analyzed this incident and below are our findings:
 For the fix of MFTBCFFR-3809 Incident, we added a Validation check where if Journal Voucher of the Body Building Order already exist then no additional trigger of Journal Voucher will be created. But in this check, condition used to search for existing Journal Voucher needs to be improved. 
 Currently, our Validation checks that if a Completed Trigger exist for that Body Building Order, but we need to update the condition to: if a trigger with any status exist then we will not create another JV trigger. 
 Duplicated Journal Voucher was created after 2 minutes of original Journal Voucher, our validation checked for Completed trigger but since original trigger was not completed at that time, another duplicate trigger was sent. We need to update our check so that if any trigger exist for Original Journal Voucher than no duplicate Journal Voucher will be created. 

This will resolve duplicate Journal Voucher issue.

Kindly check and approve our fix plan.

Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional detail.

Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya
column412:
15/Jul/25 6:07 AM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;Dear [~accountid:712020:66b35490-1d18-4551-8edc-a61d8fcec8ca] San,

いつも大変お世話になっております。

このインシデントを分析した結果、以下の通りご報告いたします。

 

MFTBCFFR-3809 インシデントの修正対応として、架装オーダーに対して既に仕訳伝票が存在する場合は、新たな仕訳伝票トリガーを作成しないよう、バリデーションチェックを追加しました。

しかしながら、既存の仕訳伝票を検索する際の条件に改善の余地があることが判明しました。

 

現在のバリデーションでは、「完了済み」のトリガーが存在するかどうかのみをチェックしていますが、今後は「ステータスに関係なく、いずれかのトリガーが存在する場合」は新たな仕訳伝票トリガーを作成しないように条件を変更する必要があります。

 

今回、重複した仕訳伝票は、元の仕訳伝票の2分後に作成されました。バリデーションは「完了済み」のトリガーのみを確認していたため、元のトリガーがまだ完了していなかった時点で、別のトリガーが送信されてしまいました。

 

したがって、今後は「元の仕訳伝票に対するいかなるトリガーが存在する場合でも」重複する仕訳伝票が作成されないようにバリデーションを修正いたします。

 

この修正により、重複仕訳伝票の問題は解消される見込みです。

 

修正案のご確認とご承認をお願いいたします。

ご不明点や追加情報が必要な場合は、お知らせください。

 

よろしくお願いいたします。

いつも大変お世話になっております。

 

以下の手順でご確認いただけます：

 

架装オーダーを作成し、ステータスの変更または「承認依頼」ボタンをクリックして最終ステータスまで完了させてください。

24/Jun/25 10:21 AM;63d377128c3018ca8a1c6fa6;Dear [@Shiromoto, Hideaki (575)|mailto:hideaki.shiromoto@daimlertruck.com] san,
 Thank you for your support. 
 
 We have thoroughly investigated and below are our findings:
 
 *User Steps:*
 * In Revision 2 and Revision 3, the UV Trade-In Flag in UV Quote Header was selected as “Y”.
 * However, in Revision 4, the user manually unchecked the flag, changing it to “N”.

If a user intends to delete the UV Trade-In Assessment, the correct process is to delete the assessment record first and then uncheck the UV Trade-In flag.

*RCA:*

When the UV Trade-In flag is unchecked in the UV Quote header, the related Trade-In fields become read-only. This prevents deletion, as certain backend field updates required during deletion cannot occur in this state.

Recovery Plan:

No recovery action is required. The user can resolve the issue by rechecking the UV Trade-In flag to “Y”. This will allow deletion of the UV Trade-In Assessment as needed.

 

*Conclusion:*

This is a case of user mis operation, not a system defect. Hence, kindly allow us to reject this incident.

Please advise the user to follow the steps outlined above. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.

いつも大変お世話になっております。

 

岡山本番環境におけるD21Aファイルのマッピングについて確認を行いました。分析結果は以下の通りです。

18/Jun/25 7:00 AM;712020:68be1aad-34a0-4a2d-8071-b4330f7d77ac;Dear Tsunoda-san,
 
Thank you very much for your continued support.
 
Regarding the issue raised, we have identified it as a case of user mis-operation. In Revision 1 of Quote 1-8OC74, the line item for 自動車税（種別割）was listed with a tax value of ¥8,600. At that stage, only the Sales Order and Invoice were created based on this revision.
 
Subsequently, in Revision 2 of the quote, the user updated the tax value for the same line item to ¥9,700. However, the Registration Request was created after this revision and derived its values from the existing invoice, which was originally generated based on Revision 1. As a result, the tax value reflected in the Registration Request remains ¥8,600.
 
To correct this, the appropriate action would have been for the user to generate a new invoice(has to cancel the existing invoice) after updating the tax value in Revision 2 of the quote.
 
Please let us know if any further clarification is needed.
 
Best regards,
Ujjwal Goel

We have replicated the issue in the UAT1 environment. Please find the details below:

Reference Record for UAT1

NV SO#: A001295706

PO#: F001295707

AR#: H000047991 (Assessment Purpose: User Purchase)

Upon investigation, we found that an Assessment Request with the assessment purpose set as ‘User Purchase’ can be directly mapped to an NV Quote as a Trade-in Vehicle. This is why the user was able to map the UV Purchase Order to the NV Sales Order.

As a countermeasure, we plan to implement a code change in the process of adding a trade-in vehicle to the NV Quote. After the change, users will only be able to map assessments in NV Quote related to Trade-in assessment purposes only.

問題は何ですか？

 原因は何ですか？
 → 本件の問題は、既存のデータマップ（バックエンド）における操作設定が「update（更新）」となっていたことに起因しています。この設定では既存レコードの変更のみが可能であるため、IBOSのレスポンスに含まれる新規の架装レコードが作成されませんでした。

05/Jun/25 5:32 AM;712020:17b0808a-2569-4316-a76d-282e067c6a25;Dear Tsunoda-san,
 Thank you for your continued support.

We have completed our analysis regarding the reported issue in the JIRA ticket. We successfully replicated the issue in the UAT environment using the reference record NV Quote #: 1-KHY8Z, Rev-3, and confirmed that this is a case of user misoperation.
 Here are the steps the user followed that led to the issue:
 1.) In NV Quote #: 1-IQZEL, Rev-2, the user added a trade-in vehicle with AR#: H000001601.
 2.) While creating Rev-3, the user removed the AR# from the trade-in vehicle line item and then deleted the record.
 3.) Subsequently, the user added a new trade-in vehicle with AR#: H000001602.

As a result of this sequence, the asset_id in the trade-in line item was cleared, leading to the display of a blank line item in the NV Quote.
 To avoid this issue, we suggest the user to delete the existing trade-in line item entirely and then, create a new line item with the desired trade-in vehicle information or to change the AR# directly without erasing it.

Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions or need further assistance.

Best regards,

Sunaina Gill

We have analyszed this issue thorughly and below are our findings:
 On 6th February, User changed the closing of the mentioned account from 20 to EOM. 
!image-2025-05-22-12-05-09-412.png|width=400,height=234!
Since, Bulk Invoice logic includes only 30 days of data, this data was not sent in February EOM. 
 These orders were supposed to be sent to KB on 20th closing, but user changed the closing from 20 to EOM. Now in Feb EOM, this data is supposed to be sent to KB but since Bulk Invoice logic only includes data of last 30 days, 20th Jan to 28th Jan data was not sent to KB. 

This is not a system bug, during initial development of the Bulk Invoice functionality, only 30 days range was included. There is a ongoing CR where we will change this range from 30 days to 60 days. By this CR, such cases will be avoided.

Thank you for your support.

This issue has been raised on 19th May at 9:46 AM JST.
As per Oracle recommendation we were using, *coe_Siebel_stats.sql* gather stats script, The script will lock tables with fewer rows. Because of this mentioned tables statistics were locked, and statistics were not collected for the tables.

To fix this issue:  Unlock stats for above tables, After unlocking run gather stats for above tables.
This issue has been resolved on 19th May at 13:45 JST.

For permanent countermeasure: We will manually run it once in a month by using DBMS statistics rather than *coe_Siebel_stats.sql* gather stats script.

Please let us know in case of any further query.

column394:
13/May/25 10:47 AM;712020:94fdcacc-0060-496d-b5c5-0c1ac9d47d4c;Dear [~accountid:712020:5fe8ae34-3387-45a6-ae3d-cedf7aac0300]-San,

Thank you for your support.

We have checked this incident and as per our analysis Recycle Invoice data was received on May 01, 2025 and in Invoice Calendar has date as  07th May, 2025, file was received earlier than it should as per invoice calendar. As per current functionality, only files received on same date as in Invoice Calendar for each month will be executed.
Since there is a time difference that is why Recycle Invoice Data file is not executed on any FDP environment. This is working as per initial requirements therefore this is not a bug. We will need an AMS CR to fix this.
For recovery we will process these files manually, for that please confirm what posting date should be set in JV?
Kindly check and let us know how you want us to proceed.

Best Regards,
Atul Yadav
column395:
13/May/25 11:33 AM;712020:1f3d9af2-2c18-4d82-999c-97eec4a352b5;Dear [~accountid:712020:5fe8ae34-3387-45a6-ae3d-cedf7aac0300] San,



いつも大変お世話になっております。

 

本インシデントにつきまして分析を行った結果、リサイクル請求書データは2025年5月1日に受信されており、請求書カレンダー上の日付は2025年5月7日となっております。これは、請求書カレンダーに定められた日付よりも早くファイルが受信されたことを意味します。

 

現在の仕様では、請求書カレンダーに記載された日付と同日に受信されたファイルのみが毎月処理対象となるため、日付の不一致により、リサイクル請求書データファイルはどのFDP環境でも実行されておりません。

 

この動作は初期要件に基づくものであり、不具合ではありません。そのため、修正を行うにはAMS-CRが必要です。

 

なお、リカバリ対応として、これらのファイルを手動で処理する予定です。その際、仕訳伝票（JV）に設定すべき計上日をご確認のうえ、ご指示ください。

 

対応方法について、ご確認の上、ご指示いただけますようお願い申し上げます。

宜しくお願い致します。

いつも大変お世話になっております。

以下に、ご質問いただいた内容に対する回答を記載いたします。

 

■MFTBCFFR-3040

①どのような内容のバグチケットですか？（履歴が長くてわかりません）

→ MFTBCFFR-3040 では、Miyauchi様より「KBに連携されているアカウントマスターデータの一部のカラムに誤ったマッピングがある」との報告がありました。

本件の不具合はインシデント内で修正済みですが、その後、Miyauchi様より追加開発のご要望があり、CRが必要となりました。

そのため、CRが本番環境にリリースされるまで、アカウントマスターの一括連携を停止してほしいとの依頼がありました。

→ MFTBCFFR-3040 にて報告された不具合は解決済みで、修正はすべてのFDP環境に適用されています。ただし、CRの本番環境への適用はまだ未実施です。

 

※残作業はありますか？

→ はい、CRの開発および本番リリースがまだ残っています。

 

■MFTBCFFR-3149

①今時点でSIEBELからKBへの特定のアカウント情報のインターフェースを止めているのですか？

→ 現在、四国の本番環境においてアカウントマスター全体の連携を停止しています。特定のアカウントに限定した対応ではなく、すべてのアカウントに対して適用されています。

 

②①の理解が正しい場合、インターフェースを止めているアカウントコードに下記は含まれていますか？

→ アカウントコード「1000007404」は4月に作成されたものです。アカウントマスターの一括連携は4月以前にすでに停止していたため、このアカウントの情報はKBには連携されていません。

 

③①の理解が正しくない場合、具体的にどのアカウントコードについていつからいつまでインターフェースを止めていたのですか？

ご不明な点がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。

 

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

* Approved
* Sales Posting Completed
* Registration Completed

24/Apr/25 6:35 AM;63d377128c3018ca8a1c6fa6;Dear [~accountid:712020:5fe8ae34-3387-45a6-ae3d-cedf7aac0300] san, [~accountid:712020:3bbdff6f-1498-435b-a25d-bf833b44b3f6] san,

Thank you for your support.

We have analysed this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
While creating Journal voucher line, system checks whether the amount is equal to zero or not. Since, we do not create zero amount JV, we have added a search specification which check if the tax amount is equal to zero or not. If the tax amount is equal to zero then JV line is not created. In this case, consumption tax amount 0.8 which should be rounded to 1. But the search specification did not follow the correct rounding procedure and estimated 0.8 as 0. Hence, no JV line was created for "Job Card Sales CT" Journal event.

Fix Plan: We will fix the search specification which follows the incorrect rounding procedure. We will share the fix on UAT1 by today EOD. Please let us know if you have any query.

Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya
column397:
24/Apr/25 6:42 AM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;宮内さん、吉原さん、

いつもお世話になっております。

本件について詳細に調査した結果、以下のとおり判明いたしました。

仕訳伝票（JV）の明細行を作成する際、システムは金額が0であるかどうかを確認しています。金額が0の仕訳伝票を作成しない仕様となっているため、税額が0であるかどうかを判定する検索条件（Search Specification）を設定しています。税額が0の場合、仕訳伝票の明細行は作成されません。

今回のケースでは、消費税額が「0.8」であり、本来であれば四捨五入により「1」となるべきところ、検索条件内で正しい四捨五入処理が行われておらず、「0」として扱われてしまいました。その結果、「Job Card Sales CT」仕訳イベントの明細行が作成されませんでした。

対応方針：
不正確な四捨五入処理を行っている検索条件を修正いたします。本修正は本日中にUAT1環境へ反映予定です。
ご不明点等ございましたら、お気軽にお知らせください。

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします

Thank you for your support.

*RCA:* The issue with the incorrect Total PO Cost in the Service Purchase Order (SPO) is as per the current system logic for calculating quantity on labor line items. Specifically, for labor code '.004330', the Zero Effort Flag is set to 'Y', the Billing Type is not 'Customer', and the PO Cost Flag is 'N'. According to the current functionality, when these conditions are met, the Quantity Requested is defaulted to 1, instead of using the actual labor effort or operation time.

As a result, the Total PO Cost is calculated using the formula:

24/Apr/25 5:22 AM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;吉原さん、

 いつもお世話になっております。

 原因分析（RCA）：
Service Purchase Order（SPO）における「Total PO Cost（発注合計金額）」が正しく表示されない問題は、作業項目（Labor Line Item）の数量を算出する現行のシステムロジックに起因しています。

具体的には、Laborコード '.004330' に対し、以下の条件が当てはまる場合：

Zero Effort Flag が 「Y」 に設定されている
Billing Type（請求区分） が 「Customer」以外 に設定されている
PO Cost Flag（発注原価計上フラグ） が 「N」 に設定されている

上記の条件がすべて満たされると、システムは実際の作業時間や工数にかかわらず、Quantity Requested（依頼数量） を 「1」 に自動設定します。

そのため、Total PO Cost（発注合計金額） は次の式により算出されます：
[Sales Unit Price（販売単価）] × 1

このようにして、実際よりも高いコストがSPOに反映されてしまう動作は、現行のバリデーションルールに基づいた設計通りの挙動です。

なお、Zero Effort Flag を 「Y」→「N」 に変更した場合、SPO上に正しい値が反映されることを確認済みです。
添付のマスターおよびSPOのスクリーンショットをご参照ください。

Batch RF Status in ("Send Shipment to RF", "Send Create to RF", "")

14/May/26 11:49 PM;712020:174306ba-1ecc-4c31-8444-d079cb3253e4;Dear [~accountid:712020:0bc59313-6096-481d-86a3-fcee0de55832] san,
Thanks for your support.

Regarding this issue, when Siebel sends a request to the TOB system, we have observed scenarios where TOB does not return a response.

In the normal process flow, TOB does not accept triggers from the Siebel side after 5:00 PM JST. If a trigger is sent to TOB after 5:00 PM JST and not accepted by TOB then the corresponding records fail in the asynchronous transaction on the Siebel side. Subsequently, a Siebel batch job runs on the next day and reprocesses all failed records by resending them to TOB.

However, in this particular case, the request was accepted by TOB, and no response was received from the TOB side. As a result, the record was not identified as failed on the Siebel side and therefore was not retriggered by the batch job on the next morning as expected.

Kindly review the above and let us know the next action required from the Cubastion side.

Please let us know in case of any queries or if any additional information is required from our side.

Best Regards,
Soham Modi

column30:

column394:
07/Apr/25 10:28 AM;712020:d808848a-012e-4529-a5ad-a058f6743515;Dear [~accountid:712020:5fe8ae34-3387-45a6-ae3d-cedf7aac0300] san,

Thanks for your continued support.

RCA: The calculation of the commission is being done when we click the "Create Spreadsheet" button in the order.
 Based on current logic, if the "Vehicle Liability Insurance Certificate Issue Date" is null, the commission fee and tax calculation is done correctly.
 This field gets populated once the "Liability Insurance Policy #" is filled in the order.

To replicate the issue, we created the liability order Q050023214 on UAT8 and followed the steps below:
 1. Create an Liability Insuracne Opportunity.
 2. Create an Liability Insuracne Quote.
 3. Create an Liability Order.
 4. Check the clerical error flag In Order.
 5. Now change the Status of Order to "Liability Clerical Error".
 6. Now uncheck the clerical error flag In Order.
 7. Now the button of "Create Spreadsheet" is enable.
 8. Now Create the Liability Spreadsheet through "Create Spreadsheet" button.

Now We get the commission fee details same Chugoku Production Order.

!image-2025-04-07-18-25-02-940.png|width=185,height=93!!image-2025-04-07-18-26-49-539.png|width=184,height=92!

Fix Plan: We recommend adding one more condition to enable the "Create Spreadsheet" button — the "Vehicle Liability Insurance Certificate Issue Date" should have a valid value before the button is enabled.

Kindly validate the RCA and approve the fix plan. 
Please let us know if any recovery is required. 

Best Regards,
 Shivam
column395:
07/Apr/25 11:08 AM;712020:95acd384-db44-4738-88dc-0efefdfc02ed;いつもお世話になっております。
 
RCA:

コミッションの計算は、注文内で「Create Spreadsheet」ボタンをクリックした際に実行されます。
 
現在のロジックに基づいて、もし「Vehicle Liability Insurance Certificate Issue Date」がnullの場合、コミッション料と税額の計算は正しく行われます。
 
このフィールドは、「Liability Insurance Policy #」が注文に入力された時点で入力されます。
 
問題を再現するために、UAT8でliability orderQ050023214を作成し、以下の手順を実行しました。
 
Liability Insuracne Opportunityを作成
 
Liability Insuracne Quoteを作成
 
Liability Orderを作成
 
注文内のClerical error flagを確認
 
注文のステータスを「Liability Clerical Error」に変更
 
注文内のClerical error flagを解除
 
「Create Spreadsheet」ボタンが有効になります
 
「Create Spreadsheet」ボタンからLiability Spreadsheetを作成
 
その結果、コミッション料の詳細は、同じく中国本番注文と同じ内容が表示されました。
!image-2025-04-07-18-25-02-940.png|width=365,height=183!
!image-2025-04-07-18-26-49-539.png|width=361,height=181!

修正案:

「Create Spreadsheet」ボタンを有効化するために、もう1つ条件を追加することを推奨いたします。すなわち、「Vehicle Liability Insurance Certificate Issue Date」が有効な値であることを確認した後に、ボタンが有効化されるべきです。
 
RCAをご確認いただき、修正案の承認をお願いいたします。
 
また、復旧作業が必要な場合はお知らせください。
 
よろしくお願い申し上げます。
Himanshu

03/Apr/25 6:18 AM;712020:c35ea606-6edf-43a3-8ee3-7e40cbae341c;Dear Shiromoto San,

Thank you for your support.

*RCA*: 
In the Power BI report, the field X_REPAIR_COST has a null value in both the Warehouse DB and Siebel DB for AR# H000109757.
Since X_REPAIR_COST is aggregated using SUM, Power BI automatically ignores null values instead of treating them as zero. As a result, AR# H000109757 does not contribute to the total sum and does not appear in visuals that display only aggregated results.

Additionally, there are multiple ARs where X_REPAIR_COST is null.

*Fix*: To address this issue, we have two possible solutions:
1. Modify the logic in ODI to convert null values of X_REPAIR_COST to 0 before loading the data.
2. Modify the logic in Power BI to handle null values appropriately.

We will finalize and implement the appropriate solution, and in the meantime, we will manually recover these records after business hours today.

Regards,
Sheetal

This is a existing functionality where during Generate Approval button in Sales Order, system checks if Recycle Fee order is mapped to the sales order. Since TOB did not share the D21F file, Recycle Order is not created. Hence system gave a validation for Recycle fee order not being mapped to the Sales order. This functionality works same as SC.

D21FFile not received --> No Recycle Fee Order --> System Validation for Recycle Fee in Sales Order

Logic is working correctly and there is no issue in the system. 

Is there any specific condition where you want that system do not give validation for Recycle fee Order? Kindly confirm.

Regards.
 Divyesh Ghiya

When user creates a Payer Change Order, values in Bill to Basic Account and Ship to basic account is fetched from JCO. Then user changes the payer in Bill to Basic Account and values in Closed Date and Payment term should be reflected according to new Payer entered. 21/Apr/25 5:35 AM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;宮内さん、

いつもお世話になっております。

問題概要：
ユーザーが支払者変更オーダーを作成する際、「Bill to Basic Account（請求先基本アカウント）」および「Ship to Basic Account（出荷先基本アカウント）」の値はJCOから取得されます。その後、ユーザーが「Bill to Basic Account」に別の支払者を入力した場合、「Closed Date（締日）」および「Payment Term（支払条件）」は、新しく入力された支払者に基づいて更新される必要があります。

しかし現状では、ユーザーが「Bill to Basic Account」に新しい支払者を入力しても「Closed Date」の値が更新されず、変更オーダーには以前の値が残ったままになります。

その結果、本件では「Closed Date」が「25」に更新されず、変更オーダーに反映されなかったため、データがKBへ送信されませんでした。もとの締日が月末（EOM）であったため、すべてのJCラインと変更オーダーラインは3月31日にKBへ送信されました。

修正計画：
「Bill to Basic Account」に新しい支払者を入力した際に「Closed Date」が正しく更新されるよう、本事象の修正を行います。
この修正は 4月24日までにUAT1環境へリリース予定 です。

After analyzing the issue, we have determined that RCA of this jira is same as MFTBCFFR 3641 that there is no city code in the address associated with the account used in the Sales Order.

We have replicated the issue on UAT 6 (Sales Order: A000026083). Below are the steps to replicate the issue:

Step 1: Create an Opportunity with Account code: 0000032930.
Step 2: Create and approve the quote.
Step 3: Create a Sales Order for the respective quote and approve the Sales Order.
Step 4: During the approval process for the Sales Posting of the Sales Order, when you attempt to approve the second approval from the Inbox, you will encounter a pop-up error. As a result, you will not be able to change the status to "Approved."
Step 5: Despite the inability to approve the Inbox, the Sales Order’s approval status in the approval history will show as "Approved," a Planned Pool Cost - Shipment Order will be created, and the status of your Order will change to "Sales Posting Completed."
Step 6: In the Inbox, when you reject the approval, the order status will change to "Rejected." You can then generate approvals again. If you repeat the process from Step 4, you will notice multiple Planned Pool Cost - Shipment Orders being generated.

Best regards,

26/Mar/25 12:51 PM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;角田さん、

いつもお世話になっております。

この問題を詳しく分析した結果、以下のような所見が得られました。

部品社内オーダーのリスト価格は新車受注（NV Sales Order）から取得されます。新車見積（NV Quote）でサブ見積（Sub Quote）を使用して部品を追加すると、新車受注の開始価格（Start Price）がnullに設定されます。

この問題をUAT1環境で再現しました。NV Sales Order「A001293389」において、サブ見積を使用して部品「###600SILVER」を追加しました。サブ見積の完了後、部品がNV見積に追加される際に開始価格がnullに設定され、それが原因で部品社内オーダー（M001293390）のリスト価格もnullになりました。

現在、この問題の修正作業を進めており、3月31日までにUAT1環境へ修正を適用する予定です。 
何かご不明点がございましたら、お知らせください。

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

31/Mar/25 11:09 AM;712020:68be1aad-34a0-4a2d-8071-b4330f7d77ac;Dear Tsunoda-san,

Thank you for your continued support.

After analyzing the issue, we have determined the root cause as follows:

Typically, when an invoice is created, the "Billing Status Code" field in the sales order items related to the invoice is updated to "Invoiced." However, in this case, this update did not occur, resulting in the creation of an additional invoice.

As this problem is rare and difficult to replicate, we have considered a preventive measure.

The preventive measure we propose involves updating the order line items where the billing code status should have been invoiced but was not processed correctly. To address this, we will trigger a workflow when the "Auto Invoice" button is clicked. The workflow will check the sales order line items whose status should have been invoiced but is not, and will update their billing code status to "Invoiced."

Please let us know if you have any feedback or concerns regarding this approach.

Best regards,
Ujjwal Goel

いつもお世話になっております。

この問題を分析した結果、根本原因を以下のように特定しました。

通常、請求書が作成されると、それに関連する受注明細の「請求ステータスコード」フィールドが「請求済み」に更新されます。しかし、今回のケースではこの更新が行われず、追加の請求書が作成されてしまいました。

この問題は発生頻度が低く、再現が困難であるため、防止策を検討しました。

提案する防止策として、本来「請求済み」に更新されるべき受注明細のステータスが処理されていない場合に、それを更新する仕組みを導入します。具体的には、「自動請求」ボタンをクリックした際にワークフローを起動し、「請求済み」に更新されるべき受注明細の請求ステータスコードをチェックし、未処理のものを「請求済み」に更新するようにします。

この対応方針について、ご意見やご懸念がございましたらお知らせください。

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

*>2100年3月18日でもKBはエラーにならないということですか？*

Siebelのロジックに基づいて、仕訳伝票に正しく計上日が表示されているかを確認できます。特定の仕訳伝票の計上日に関する問題が発生した場合は、宮内さんから連絡をいただいています。現在、IBOSから受信した日付が実出荷日として表示され、そのまま仕訳伝票の計上日として反映されます。そのため、実出荷日として2100年3月18日が受信された場合、それが仕訳伝票にも反映されます。

ボディビルディングオーダーの実出荷日が空欄の場合、仕訳伝票には現在のタイムスタンプが表示されます。

*RCA:* The issue occurs due to data migration and editable Sales Order # field in UV Inventory screen.
In FDP a new flag “Previous Assessment Flag” was created which is set to Y for all the UV Pool Cost-Procurement, Job Card Order and UV Body Building Orders if the parent UV Sales Order is Sales Posting Completed. This flag ensures that purchase orders associated with old UV Sales Order are not visible on UI if the vehicle is stocked in again.

During data migration, this flag was not set to “Y” so user was able to see all the previous purchase orders on UI and was able to change the Sales Order #.

*Preventive Measures:* We will perform recovery for all the migrated order tonight so that they are not visible under UV Inventory screen after restock in.

Also, we suggest to make this field read only on UI because user can change the Sales Order # for any purchase order that is associated with stocked in vehicle and KB Map/Unmap trigger is not created in this user operation.

11/Mar/25 12:47 PM;712020:d808848a-012e-4529-a5ad-a058f6743515;Dear [~accountid:712020:dbf7f898-3454-4f75-8ca2-b7a587098967] san, 

Thanks for your continued support.
 We have investigated above issue and below are our findings.
 1. User is able to do the Sales Posting even if the JCO is not created(Service Quote is not "Customer Approved"). As per the current functionality in FDP, there is no check while doing sales positng if there is no JCO. 
 2. As soon as Service Quote status changes to "Customer Approved" JCO is created and now without closing the respective Job Card user will not be able to do the Sales Posting.

In above Sales Order, it seems there is a user mis operation. The user may not have progressed the Service Quote to "Customer Approved", which prevented the creation of JCO. As per FDP's functionality, Sales Posting is still allowed.

In SC version, there is a validation for the first point — when changing the status of a Delivery Request to "Completed", a validation message is displayed.
 Please let us know if we need to implement a similar validation in FDP as well.

Best Regards,
 Shivam
column398:
11/Mar/25 2:37 PM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;Hi [~accountid:712020:dbf7f898-3454-4f75-8ca2-b7a587098967]  san

いつもお世話になっております。

本件について調査を行い、以下の点を確認いたしました。

1. JCO が作成されていない場合（Service Quote が「Customer Approved」になっていない場合）でも、ユーザーは Sales Posting を行うことが可能です。現行の FDP の仕様では、JCO の有無を Sales Posting の際にチェックする仕組みはありません。 
2. 一方、Service Quote のステータスが「Customer Approved」に変更されると JCO が作成され、それ以降は該当する Job Card をクローズしない限り Sales Posting は行えません。

今回の Sales Order については、ユーザー操作の誤りである可能性があります。ユーザーが Service Quote を「Customer Approved」に進めなかったため、JCO が作成されず、その状態でも FDP の仕様上 Sales Posting が許可されたと考えられます。

なお、SC バージョンでは 1 点目のケースに対して、Delivery Request のステータスを「Completed」に変更する際に、検証メッセージが表示される仕様となっています。

FDP においても同様のバリデーションを実装する必要があるか、ご確認のほどお願いいたします。

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

20/Jul/26 8:34 AM;712020:daf1fd8e-4d9a-44c5-9de9-3caa1969d6e6;Dear Tsunoda San, 

Thanks for your support. 

Please find below the analysis details for incident *MFTBCFFR: 3546* regarding the issue where the recycle order was not displayed in the Chugoku Production environment.

*Root Cause Analysis (RCA):*
The *D21F* file was received and processed before the *D21A* file. Since the chassis record had not yet been created during the D21A file execution, the recycle fee order could not be created during the D21F execution.

*Recovery Action:*
As part of the recovery, the *D21F* process was re-executed after the successful completion of the *D21A* process. This resulted in the successful creation of the recycle fee order.

*Countermeasure:*
As this issue was caused by the sequence of *TOB* file processing and is *not related to the Siebel system*, we are unable to provide a Siebel-side countermeasure for this scenario.

*Monitoring:*
To avoid such errors, Cubastion has configured email notifications to alert the team whenever any file execution fails. This enables us to promptly identify unprocessed or failed files and take timely recovery actions whenever required.

Since this issue was caused by the TOB file processing sequence and is not related to the Siebel system, we would like to proceed with closing this Jira ticket.

Best Regards,
Deepika Raheja

column397:
10/Mar/25 3:44 AM;712020:d63ea065-10c2-4600-b2ca-b39cd2cdb701;Dear [@Shiromoto, Hideaki (575)|mailto:hideaki.shiromoto@daimlertruck.com] san, 
 
Thank you for your support.
 
*RCA*: In this case the sequence of events is as mentioned below: # 
User created order from quote with 2 Part items.
 # 
User created the Parts internal order and then the return order for both the items Part Items.
 # 
User revised the quote.
 # 
Deleted the old items (2 parts) and added the new Part items (2 parts).

The sequence of events happened in such a manner that the same line number was assigned to the new Part Items also. So, when the user synced the Quote and Order.
It got synced with existing part items rather creating new items.
And as the Part orders were already created for the older items. Therefore, the operation got stuck.
As this is a very rare scenario to occur, we request the business team to let us monitor if there is any further such any occurrence in the system to have a better and efficient solution to control this issue.
*Recovery*: Recovery is completed for the affected record.
 
In case of any further query, please let us know.
Regards
Ashutosh Dogra
column398:
10/Mar/25 8:10 AM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;Dear @Shiromoto, Hideaki (575) San,

いつも大変お世話になっております。

RCA: 本件における事象の経緯は以下の通りです。
ユーザーが2つの部品アイテムを含む見積から注文を作成しました。
ユーザーが「Parts Internal Order」を作成し、その後、両方の部品アイテムに対する「Return order」を作成しました。
ユーザーが見積改訂をしました。
古いアイテム（2つの部品）を削除し、新しい部品アイテム（2つの部品）を追加しました。
このような一連の流れにより、新しい部品アイテムにも同じ行番号が割り当てられました。そのため、ユーザーが見積もりと注文を同期した際に、既存の部品アイテムと同期され、新しいアイテムが作成されませんでした。 さらに、部品注文はすでに古いアイテムについて作成されていたため、操作が停止しました。
この事象は非常に稀なケースであるため、今後同様の事象が発生するかどうかをシステムで監視し、この問題を制御するためのより良い効率的な解決策を見つけるために、ビジネスチームにご確認いただけますようお願い申し上げます。
回復: 影響を受けたレコードについては、回復が完了しました。
ご不明点がございましたら、どうぞお知らせください。

よろしくお願いいたします。

Thank you for your support.

For this issue the probable fixes are as follows:

*Issue:* In D21Z file the date which is received from the TOB side does is in the format of *MMDD*  and not having the Year.

*Fix Plan-1*: Considering the Shipment date will be older than the  D21Z file execution data. We will compare the Shipment date received in the file to the file execution date and if the Shipment date is greater than the file execution date in the format of *MMDD* then we will take the previous year. Otherwise the current year. 

This change needs to be handled at the ODI side. So a project CR will be required for this.

*Fix Plan 2:* As the Shipment date is already updated by the D21N file. So, the Shipment date updating process from D21Z file will be stopped. This can be done by AMS-CR

*Fix Plan 3*: If TOB can send the year in the D21Z file then we can update the same in the Siebel system.

These are the probable fix plans to handle these types of issues.

In case a detailed discussion is required, we can also schedule a call for the same.

Regards

Ashutosh Dogra
column400:
11/Mar/25 1:17 AM;712020:d63ea065-10c2-4600-b2ca-b39cd2cdb701;角田さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
本件の問題について、以下のような対応案を考えております。
■ 問題点
D21Zファイルにおいて、TOB側から受領する日付がMMDD形式となっており、Year（年）の情報が含まれていません。
■ 対応案 
① 修正案1
Shipment DateはD21Zファイルの実行日より過去の日付であることを前提とし、以下のルールで処理を行います。 
Shipment Date（MMDD形式）がファイル実行日より大きい場合：前年を適用
それ以外の場合：当年を適用
この変更はODI側での対応が必要となるため、プロジェクトCRの申請が必要です。
② 修正案2
Shipment DateはすでにD21Nファイルにより更新されているため、D21ZファイルからのShipment Date更新処理を停止する対応です。
この場合、AMS-CRにて対応可能です。
③ 修正案3
TOB側でD21ZファイルにYear(年)の情報を含めていただける場合、それをSiebelシステムに反映する形で対応可能です。
以上が今回の問題に対する対応案となります。
ご不明点や詳細なご相談が必要な場合は、別途お打ち合わせを設定することも可能ですので、必要でしたら、ご連絡ください。

02/Jul/25 5:49 AM;712020:17b0808a-2569-4316-a76d-282e067c6a25;Dear Shiromoto san

Thank you for your support.

We have fixed this issue in FDP UAT environment.

Issue: Field related to Customer were null on UV Sales Order.

This issue occured because the field 'Customer Name' was not Read-Only on UV Sales Order screen. Using this field user is able to Remove Customer Name from UV Sales Order. Upon nullifying this filed will also nullify Field "Customer Name", "Bill To Account" and "Payer Account".

To fix this issue, we have made the field 'Customer Name' as Read-Only.

  !image-2025-07-02-11-18-53-452.png|width=390,height=193!

Now user will not be able to remove customer name manually and hence Field related to Customer will not become null.

Kindly verify and approve for prod implementation. Please let us know in case of any query.

Regards

03/Mar/25 3:17 PM;712020:d808848a-012e-4529-a5ad-a058f6743515;Dear [~accountid:712020:3bbdff6f-1498-435b-a25d-bf833b44b3f6] san,

Thanks for your continued support.

This is due to inconsistent data in SC Prod.
In Vehicle there are 3 columns, X_KEY, SERIAL_NUM, ASSET_NUM. Ideally these three column should have same value. But In the above case, ASSET_NUM "FK62F-605267", the value in X_KEY and SERIAL_NUM is "FU74HZ-510966". 
In data migration we have used ASSET_NUM as the user key, and the value in X_KEY and SERIAL_NUM is same as ASSET_NUM in Chugoku Production. 

Please let us know if you have any further query.

Best Regards,

Shivam

車両にはX_KEY、SERIAL_NUM、ASSET_NUMの3つのカラムがあり、理想的にはこれらのカラムは同じ値を持つべきです。しかし、上記のケースでは、ASSET_NUM「FK62F-605267」に対して、X_KEYおよびSERIAL_NUMの値は「FU74HZ-510966」となっています。
データ移行時には、ユーザーキーとしてASSET_NUMを使用し、X_KEYおよびSERIAL_NUMの値は中国本番においてASSET_NUMと同じものを使用しました。

その他ご質問がございましたら、お知らせください。

よろしくお願いいたします。

*RCA:*
Currently, our logic retrieves Profit (Sales Price - Cost Price) based on the formula: *Cost Price = Cost * Quantity*, regardless of the DELETE_FLG status in the Datamart database.

However, line items deleted from the Siebel side still exist in the Datamart DB, marked with *DELETE_FLG = 'Y'*, while active line items in Siebel are marked as *DELETE_FLG = 'N'* in Datamart.

Since the PBI report doesn't have a filter to separate deleted line items, causing the difference in Profit values between the PBI report and Siebel.

いつもお世話になっております。

本件について詳細に分析した結果、根本原因を特定しました。架装発注に負のコストおよびリスト価格が設定されている場合、販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存され、それが問題を引き起こしていることが判明しました。

以下の手順で問題を再現しました。

**再現手順:**
1. 見積に架装発注アイテムを追加し、リスト価格とコストの両方を負の値で入力する。
2. 見積を承認し、その見積を基にオーダーを作成する。
3. オーダーを承認し、「Create Purchase Order」ボタンをクリックして架装発注の発注書を作成する。
4. 架装発注の発注書を承認し、その後、見積を修正する。修正後、架装発注オーダーに見積アイテムが同期される。

**根本原因分析 (RCA):**
「Create Purchase Order」ボタンを使用して架装発注の発注書を作成すると、ワークフローがトリガーされます。しかし、負の価格のバリデーションによってこのワークフローが中断されます。その結果、架装発注オーダーに販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存されます。
その後、見積を修正すると、同じQuote IDを持つすべての販売オーダーを検索し、行アイテムを同期します。このため、Quote IDを持つ架装発注オーダーの行アイテムも、販売オーダーと一緒に同期されてしまいます。

**UATでの再現:**
 - **架装発注オーダー:** B001292881 (UAT 1)
 - **販売オーダー:** A001292880 (UAT 1)

RCA: In this case it seems that there is some user operation steps involved:
Step 1- User created the UV Sales Order from UV Sales Quote.

We have replicated the issue on UAT-01, reference order: E001292965.

05/Mar/25 12:50 PM;712020:37fe73dd-d299-42bc-841b-6a62e095b6ee;角田さん、

いつもお世話になっております。 
 
本件について詳細に分析した結果、根本原因を特定しました。架装発注に負のコストおよびリスト価格が設定されている場合、販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存され、それが問題を引き起こしていることが判明しました。 
 
以下の手順で問題を再現しました。 
 
**再現手順:** 
1. 見積に架装発注アイテムを追加し、リスト価格とコストの両方を負の値で入力する。 
2. 見積を承認し、その見積を基にオーダーを作成する。 
3. オーダーを承認し、「Create Purchase Order」ボタンをクリックして架装発注の発注書を作成する。 
4. 架装発注の発注書を承認し、その後、見積を修正する。修正後、架装発注オーダーに見積アイテムが同期される。 
 
**根本原因分析 (RCA):** 
「Create Purchase Order」ボタンを使用して架装発注の発注書を作成すると、ワークフローがトリガーされます。しかし、負の価格のバリデーションによってこのワークフローが中断されます。その結果、架装発注オーダーに販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存されます。 
その後、見積を修正すると、同じQuote IDを持つすべての販売オーダーを検索し、行アイテムを同期します。このため、Quote IDを持つ架装発注オーダーの行アイテムも、販売オーダーと一緒に同期されてしまいます。 
 
**UATでの再現:** 
- **架装発注オーダー:** B001292881 (UAT 1) 
- **販売オーダー:** A001292880 (UAT 1) 
 
本件のUAT環境での修正予定日は **3月7日** です。 
 
ご不明点や追加のサポートが必要な場合は、お知らせください。

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

お世話になっております。
返事が遅くなり申し訳ありません。

**■ 問題の概要** 
本件はデータ移行に起因して発生しました。

**■ 根本原因** 
請求書ステータスが **「完了」** の場合、本来であれば請求書の **行番号**（中国環境）が **「税金」** タイプの注文明細に紐づくはずでした。

**■ 対応策** 
該当レコードを修正し、中国環境の **新しい行番号** に紐づける対応を実施しました。

**■ 再発防止策** 
本件はデータ移行時の設定ミスによるものであり、今後同様の問題が発生しないよう注意を払います。

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
ハーシュ

We have investigated further, and here are the additional details:

When the daily settlement process is performed through SonpoWeb, two interfaces are triggered:
IFIN010 (Daily Settlement) – From Siebel to SonpoWeb
IFIN011 (Settlement Confirmation) – From SonpoWeb to Siebel

In IFIN011, Siebel receives encoded data, which is then decoded within Siebel. An example of the encoded data is attached for your reference.
[^MFTBCFFR-3362_Reference_EncodedData_IFIN011.docx]

From this decoded data, Siebel extracts values for the following fields:
 * Policy Number
 * PPR Receive Date
 * PPR Confirm Date
 * PPR Gross Premium
 * PPR Collection Fee
 * Agent Commission Fee
 * PPR Net Premium
 * Insurance Company Code
 * Sales Rep

Siebel then checks whether the received *Policy Number* exists. If it does, a record is created in Siebel with the extracted values.

Please let us know if you have any further query.

Best regards,
Shivam

日次決済処理が SonpoWeb を通じて実行される際に、以下の 2 つのインターフェースがトリガーされます。 
- *IFIN010（Daily Settlement）*：Siebel から SonpoWeb へ送信 
- *IFIN011（Settlement Confirmation）*：SonpoWeb から Siebel へ送信

IFIN011 では、Siebel はエンコードされたデータを受信し、それを Siebel 内でデコードします。エンコードされたデータの例を添付しておりますので、ご参照ください。 
[^MFTBCFFR-3362_Reference_EncodedData_IFIN011.docx]

デコード後、Siebel は以下の項目を抽出します。 
- ポリシー番号 
- PPR受領日 
- PPR確認日 
- PPR総保険料 
- PPR回収手数料 
- 代理店手数料 
- PPR純保険料 
- 保険会社コード 
- 営業担当者

その後、Siebel は受信したポリシー番号が既に存在するかを確認し、存在する場合は、上記の値を用いて Siebel 内にレコードを作成します。

以下、本件のRCAについてご確認ください。ご不明点がございましたら、お知らせください。

RCA

1. *最初の外部WO作成*
 - ユーザーが *2025/01/29 15:54:31* に *外部WO (1-E6M77)* を作成し、対応する *SPO (J000188523)* が生成されました。
 - 本WOの作業開始日時は *2025/01/30 18:46:06、作業完了日時は **2025/01/30 18:46:08* です。
 !screenshot-1.png|thumbnail!
 - SPOの作業開始日時および作業完了日時は *JCヘッダー* から取得されます。
 - JCヘッダーの作業開始日時は、最初に作業が開始されたWO（今回のケースでは *1-E6M77*）の開始時間です。
 - JCヘッダーの作業完了日時は、最後に完了したWO（今回のケースでは *1-E4SST）の完了時間（2025/01/30 18:46:45*）です。
 - *SPOのステータスが「Completion of Acceptance Inspection」に設定されたタイミングでJVが作成され、JVのPosting DateはSPOの作業完了日時が設定されます。*
 - したがって、SPO *J000188523* のJVのPosting Dateは *2025/01/30* となりました。
 !screenshot-2.png|thumbnail!

2. *新たな外部WO作成（Re-editモード）*
 - ユーザーが *2025/02/19 13:57:28* に *外部WO (1-F9HQT)* を作成し、対応する *SPO (J000192078)* を *Re-editモード* で生成しました。
 - 本WOの作業開始日時は *2025/02/19 14:05:03、作業完了日時は **2025/02/19 14:05:04* です。
 !screenshot-3.png|thumbnail!
 - *JCヘッダーの作業開始日時は、引き続き最初のWO（1-E6M77）の開始時間となります。*
 - *JCヘッダーの作業完了日時は、最後に完了したWO（今回のケースでは 1-F9HQT）の完了時間（2025/02/19 14:05:04）となります。*
 - *SPOのステータスが「Completion of Acceptance Inspection」に設定された際にJVが作成され、Posting DateにはSPOの作業完了日時が設定されるべきですが、今回はSPO J000192078のJVのPosting Dateが2025/01/30のままになりました。*
 - これは、*1-F9HQTの作業完了日時がJCヘッダーに正しく設定されていなかったため* です。
 !screenshot-4.png|thumbnail!

3. *承認ボタンの影響*
 - ユーザーが *MF Job Card Detail Appletで「Generate Approval」ボタンをクリックしたタイミング* で、JCヘッダーの作業完了日時が更新されました。
 - その結果、*2025/02/19 14:05:04* がJCヘッダーに設定され、両方のSPOに反映されました。
 - ただし、*SPO画面では作業開始日時・作業完了日時がJCヘッダーから取得されるため、JVとSPOの日時に不整合が発生しました。*

RCA- In this case the TOB response was not getting reflected on the UI. The issue was the JMS connections was getting lost in middle of the response processing. 

The Error Code which we get in the JMS logs: "parseResponse\{"Error":"Logon Request 18 was abandoned after 1739853464288 ms. Connection: e00080 due to connection shutdown request Connection reset(SBL-JCA-00303)"}"

To fix this issue we will increase the JMS connection Pool Side (increased from 60-90) to accommodate the requests for all the FDPs altogether .

Note: Only JMS level changes are required. No Siebel level changes are required.

Regards

Ashutosh Dogra

RCA:
今回のケースでは、TOBのレスポンスがUIに反映されない問題が発生しました。
原因としては、レスポンス処理の途中でJMS接続が切断されていたことが判明しました。

JMSログで確認されたエラーコード: "parseResponse\{"Error":"Logon Request 18 was abandoned after 1739853464288 ms. Connection: e00080 due to connection shutdown request Connection reset(SBL-JCA-00303)"}"

対応策:
本件の解決のため、JMS接続プールサイズを 60から90に増加 し、すべてのFDPのリクエストを処理できるように調整します。

対応のご承認のお願い:

注:
本対応ではJMSレベルの変更のみが必要であり、Siebelの変更は不要です。

よろしくお願いいたします。
